intro: Lebanon is a parliamentary republic where top jobs are divided between religious communities.

chapters.title: Sharing power
text: By custom, the president is a Maronite Christian, the prime minister a Sunni Muslim, and the speaker of parliament a Shia Muslim. Parliament's 128 seats are split equally between Christians and Muslims.
Deadlock is common: Lebanon went without a president for over two years before Joseph Aoun was elected in January 2025.

chapters.title: Challenges
text: Hezbollah's armed wing, corruption and the collapse of the banks have weakened the state.
